{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Remove the QA order(s) with revenue = 999999.99
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Print the number of remaining orders
print(len(loyal_completed_clean))

# Compute the mean revenue after removing the QA order
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(mean_revenue_clean)"}
